messages:
ada: Quick follow-up on the postmortem actions — I sketched an owner + due suggestion. We currently have 6 open items, two are unassigned (API cache invalidation and canary rollback automation). Can people confirm ownership or nominate a deputy by EOD today? I'll list below.

sanjay: I can take the `cache invalidation` item. ETA Thu 2026-03-24. Will open a PR and link it here.

kelly: I can pick up the canary rollback automation, but need eng-infra help for the runbook. pinging @miguel for infra support :eyes: 

miguel: available. fyi we have a slot for a canary window next Tue. I'll sync runbook + automation by Mon morning.

pm_zoe: Important: we need business sign-off for the rollback thresholds. @ada can you confirm who from product will sign off? Also need cross-team deps: sales-rep for alerting change.

ada: I'll loop in @nina-product. For owner-less items I also added quick instructions so someone can pick them without deep context. See checklist:
```
- api cache invalidation -> owner: sanjay -> due: 2026-03-24
- canary rollback automation -> owner: kelly (infra: miguel) -> due: 2026-03-23
- alerting thresholds update -> owner: pm_zoe -> due: 2026-03-22
- postmortem doc final edits -> owner: ada -> due: 2026-03-21
- incident blameless notes -> owner: miguel -> due: 2026-03-21
- cleanup cassettes -> unassigned -> suggested owner: anyone on eng-sre -> due: 2026-03-25
```

sanjay: acked, assigning draft PR #452 and will ping for review.

kelly: ack, will add runbook section and tests. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Reminder set — owners, please update the action tracker with the PR link or wiki page. I'll post a follow-up tomorrow at 09:00 UTC.

pm_zoe: If anyone can't hit due date, reply here with new ETA so we can stagger cutover. No silent misses please.

ada: thanks all. If no objections I'll mark actions as owned in the tracker in 4 hours.
